response.sql:
WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    COUNT(ram.riskandmarginpivot) as record_count
  FROM riskandmargin ram
  INNER JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT 
  acctscope,
  record_count,
  record_count::float / SUM(record_count) OVER ()::float as fraction_of_total,
  record_count::float * COUNT(*) OVER () / SUM(record_count) OVER ()::float as divided_by_average
FROM scope_counts
ORDER BY acctscope

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in users.acctscope are treated as a distinct group in the aggregation. The request does not specify whether to exclude NULL scopes or include them alongside defined enum values (Margin, Spot, Options, Futures).

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude records where users.acctscope is NULL, aggregating only over defined account scope enum values.
